data.title: I Found Malware in a BeamNG Mod
data.author: davikr
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了作者在BeamNG.drive游戏中的一款模组（American Road）中发现了恶意软件。起初，作者在启动游戏时收到防病毒软件的警告，提示有可疑的`curl.exe`活动。通过使用Process Monitor和WinDbg等工具，作者确认了问题源自游戏内的模组管理器，并追踪到模组"American Road"中的可疑JavaScript代码。该代码试图加载一个不存在的"banner.c_css"文件，并使用了不必要的XMLHttpRequest。进一步分析发现，该代码利用了Chromium Embedded Framework的漏洞，将shellcode注入内存，执行恶意命令。最终，作者通过逐一启用模组，确认了"American Road"模组是问题来源，并提醒用户小心此类恶意模组。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：BeamNG和BeamMP项目中的安全问题，尤其是与模组（mods）相关的潜在恶意代码和安全漏洞。

不同观点：
• lionkor（BeamMP前项目经理和开发者）指出，BeamMP作为一个受欢迎的多人游戏模组，面临严重的安全挑战。模组可以通过多种方式突破BeamNG的沙盒，包括进行网络请求、调用系统API等。虽然团队已经修复了许多漏洞，但由于模组分发网站常包含恶意软件，安全隐患仍然存在。此外，BeamMP由于缺乏资金支持，在安全性上的投入有限。
  
• davikr 提到，BeamNG.drive之前就曾因安全问题被利用（如禁用ASLR导致迪士尼被黑），而此次问题是由于禁用了CEF沙盒，质疑开发者为何要关闭常规的安全功能。

• abhisek 关心模组开发者是否故意植入了恶意代码，还是他们自身也被外部攻击者利用，成为了攻击下游用户的工具。

• Cloudef 对为何在使用CEF（Chromium Embedded Framework）时不开启沙盒提出疑问，质疑开发团队的技术决策。

• everdrive 关注恶意软件是否通过Proton（一种兼容工具）对主机操作系统造成了实质性影响，暗示对Linux环境下运行Windows游戏的安全担忧。

• fifteen1506 分享了在Android应用中发现可疑行为的经历，提到在GrapheneOS上运行时崩溃的问题，并对如何处理这种情况表示困惑，反映出普通用户在面对潜在恶意软件时的无力感。

补充讨论：
• TZubiri 提到在移动端访问时背景颜色变化过快，带来了不适的用户体验，虽然与安全问题无关，但指出了用户体验方面的问题。
• lopanapol 的评论较为简短，没有具体讨论技术问题，可能只是表达对主题的关注。

争议焦点：
• BeamNG和BeamMP团队为何选择禁用ASLR和CEF沙盒，这一决策被认为是导致安全漏洞的重要原因。
• 模组开发者是否故意植入恶意代码，或者他们也是外部攻击的受害者，这涉及到责任归属问题。
• 用户在面对恶意软件时的应对能力有限，尤其是在开源社区和免费项目中，如何有效提升安全性成为一个讨论热点。

How I Found Malware in a BeamNG Mod
Published April 26, 2025
•
Updated April 28, 2025
cybersecurity
malware analysis
game modding
WARNING
: This post contains snippets of code from real malware.
Do not run any of the code in this post outside of a secure, isolated virtual machine.
Last week, I fired up
BeamNG.drive
hoping to enjoy a ride around Belasco City.
But, just after I launched the game, I noticed an odd notification from my antivirus software.
curl.exe
? That can’t be good.
Cloudflare Radar
confirmed
the domain
curl
tried to access is known to be malicious.
At this point, however, I wasn’t 100% sure this came from the game.
Starting the investigation
To find out if the problem was indeed in the game, I re-launched it with
Process Monitor
running.
Filtering through the events, my suspicion was confirmed: a process launching
cmd
with a
curl
command was spawned by the game.
But where exactly was this command coming from? Was it a mod, or was the game itself compromised?
Inspecting the call stack in Process Monitor shows the command was executed by calling
WinExec
, a legacy function from 16-bit Windows that is commonly used in shellcode malware.
To take a closer look, I attached the
WinDbg
debugger to the game process and set a breakpoint on
WinExec
.
When the malicious code tries to run the command, the debugger will pause the process and allow me to inspect the call stack and memory.
That breakpoint was hit at the exact moment I opened the in-game mod manager.
WinDbg shows which memory address
WinExec
was called at, and we can use that to find the shellcode that executed the command.
But how did this shellcode even get there in the first place?
Unfortunately, the call stack doesn’t show us which file it came from, but it does contain another clue:
libcef
.
This refers to the
Chromium Embedded Framework
, which suggests a vulnerability in Chromium might have been exploited to insert the shellcode into memory.
BeamNG.drive uses Chromium to render parts of the UI, including the mod manager where the malicious code was executed.
I disabled all my downloaded mods and dug deeper.
The mod
I had a few more clues to help narrow down my search:
When I previously played the game 2 months ago, there was nothing suspicious.
The malicious command was spawned when I opened the in-game mod manager.
Disabling all mods stopped the suspicious event from appearing.
Using this info, I focused on the mods I had installed or updated in the last 2 months.
After unpacking the mod
.zip
files and searching through dozens upon dozens of Lua files, I found… nothing.
Looking through that many files was just too slow. I needed to find out exactly which mod was causing the problem.
With any luck, the moment I enabled the problematic mod, the suspicious event would reappear, so I started to enable them one by one.
And sure enough, it came back when I turned on a mod called
American Road
.
The dropper
Now that I knew which mod was the culprit, finding the malicious code should be much easier.
First stage
It didn’t take long to find some suspicious JavaScript code in a file named
american_road_patreon_banner.js

data.title: Windows RDP lets you log-in using revoked passwords. Microsoft is ok with that
data.author: drpixie
data.article_summary: 微软表示，不计划修改Windows中的远程登录协议，该协议允许用户在更改密码后仍能使用已撤销的密码进行远程登录。这一设计决策旨在确保用户不会被锁定，即使系统长时间离线，至少一个用户账户始终能登录。独立安全研究员Daniel Wade指出，这一行为违背了用户的普遍预期，即更改密码应切断所有关联设备的访问权限。旧密码可通过RDP持续访问机器，绕过云验证和多因素认证。微软认为这不构成安全漏洞，不会进行修改。这一问题源于本地存储的凭证缓存机制，可能导致安全风险，尤其是在账户凭证泄露的情况下。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：微软Windows系统中缓存的离线凭据行为是否是设计缺陷或安全问题

不同观点：
• Someone1234：认为这不是一个bug，而是一个设计决策。离线访问功能在某些情况下至关重要，尤其是在无法配置网络的情况下。尽管改进措施可能会受到批评，微软仍应尝试改进，比如定期与AD或Microsoft登录验证离线凭据。虽然这些改进并非绝对安全，但仍是“尽力而为”的提升。

• kryogen1c：认为缓存的本地凭据和保存的远程桌面协议（RDP）凭据长期存在，且可以通过组策略（GPO）设置进行管理。质疑讨论者是否在工作组环境中测试而非域环境，并指出如果时间过长，缓存的凭据将失效。

• gerdesj：对讨论内容持怀疑态度，认为RDP密码经过加密和加盐处理，除非在ADUC中勾选特定选项，否则不会以明文存储。质疑微软声明“设计决策确保至少一个用户账户始终能够登录”的真正含义。

• photon_rancher：确认在Windows AD登录中，若在脱机状态下更改密码，旧密码仍可使用。如果恢复网络连接，系统可能会接受旧密码，但输入错误密码会触发域检查，导致登录窗口挂起。虽然行为不理想，但可能在域设置中可配置。

• notnmeyer：认为这种行为是不可接受的，表示震惊和反对。

• politelemon：个人经验表明在企业域环境中无法利用这种行为，访问被拒绝。

补充讨论：
• Someone1234提到UAC作为类似例子，指出这种改进并非真正的安全边界，但仍是“尽力而为”的提升。
• kryogen1c暗示讨论者可能在寻求bug bounty（漏洞赏金），并提到无缓存需要always-on VPN等设置。
• gerdesj提到自己主要使用Linux，对Windows中的此类问题感到厌烦。
• photon_rancher详细描述了在线和离线状态下密码验证的行为差异，并指出域同步速度慢可能导致登录体验差。

争议焦点：
• 核心争议在于微软的离线凭据行为是否是一个设计缺陷，还是为了确保可用性的必要设计决策。有人认为这是不可接受的安全风险，而另一些人则认为在某些情况下这是必要的功能。

From the department of head scratches comes this counterintuitive news: Microsoft says it has no plans to change a remote login protocol in Windows that allows people to log in to machines using passwords that have been revoked.
Password changes are among the first steps people should take in the event that a password has been leaked or an account has been compromised. People expect that once they've taken this step, none of the devices that relied on the password can be accessed.
Not just a bug
The
Remote Desktop Protocol
—the proprietary mechanism built into Windows for allowing a remote user to log in to and control a machine as if they were directly in front of it—however, will in many cases continue trusting a password even after a user has changed it. Microsoft says the behavior is a design decision to ensure users never get locked out.
Independent security researcher Daniel Wade reported the behavior earlier this month to the Microsoft Security Response Center. In the report, he provided step-by-step instructions for reproducing the behavior. He went on to warn that the design defies nearly universal expectations that once a password has been changed, it can no longer give access to any devices or accounts associated with it.
“This Isn’t Just a Bug. It’s a Trust Breakdown,” Wade wrote in his report. “People trust that changing their password will cut off unauthorized access.” He continued:
It’s the first thing anyone does after suspecting compromise. And yet:
Old credentials continue working for RDP—even from brand-new machines.
Defender, Entra ID, and Azure don’t raise any flags.
There is no clear way for end-users to detect or fix the issue.
No Microsoft documentation or guidance addresses this scenario directly.
Even newer passwords may be ignored while older ones continue to function.
The result? Millions of users—at home, in small businesses, or hybrid work setups—are unknowingly at risk.

The ability to use a revoked password to log in through RDP occurs when a Windows machine that’s signed in with a Microsoft or Azure account is configured to enable remote desktop access. In that case, users can log in over RDP with a dedicated password that’s validated against a locally stored credential. Alternatively, users can log in using the credentials for the online account that was used to sign in to the machine.
A screenshot of an RDP configuration window showing a Microsoft account (for Hotmail) has remote access.

The result: persistent RDP access that bypasses cloud verification, multifactor authentication, and Conditional Access policies.
Wade and another expert in Windows security said that the little-known behavior could prove costly in scenarios where a Microsoft or Azure account has been compromised, for instance when the passwords for them have been publicly leaked. In such an event, the first course of action is to change the password to prevent an adversary from using it to access sensitive resources. While the password change prevents the adversary from logging in to the Microsoft or Azure account, the old password will give an adversary access to the user’s machine through RDP indefinitely.
“This creates a silent, remote backdoor into any system where the password was ever cached,” Wade wrote in his report. “Even if the attacker never had access to that system, Windows will still trust the password.”
Will Dormann, a senior vulnerability analyst at security firm Analygence, agreed.
"It doesn't make sense from a security perspective," he wrote in an online interview. "If I'm a sysadmin, I'd expect that the moment I change the password of an account, then that account's old credentials cannot be used anywhere. But this is not the case."

The first time a user logs in using Microsoft or Azure account credentials, RDP will confirm the password's validity online. Windows then stores the credential in a cryptographically secured format on the local machine. From then on, Windows will validate any password entered during an RDP login by comparing it against the locally stored credential, with no online lookup. 43852016.article_summary: 微软表示，不计划修改Windows中的远程登录协议，该协议允许用户在更改密码后仍能使用已撤销的密码进行远程登录。这一设计决策旨在确保用户不会被锁定，即使系统长时间离线，至少一个用户账户始终能登录。独立安全研究员Daniel Wade指出，这一行为违背了用户的普遍预期，即更改密码应切断所有关联设备的访问权限。旧密码可通过RDP持续访问机器，绕过云验证和多因素认证。微软认为这不构成安全漏洞，不会进行修改。这一问题源于本地存储的凭证缓存机制，可能导致安全风险，尤其是在账户凭证泄露的情况下。

主要讨论点：微软Windows系统中缓存的离线凭据行为是否是设计缺陷或安全问题

不同观点：
• Someone1234：认为这不是一个bug，而是一个设计决策。离线访问功能在某些情况下至关重要，尤其是在无法配置网络的情况下。尽管改进措施可能会受到批评，微软仍应尝试改进，比如定期与AD或Microsoft登录验证离线凭据。虽然这些改进并非绝对安全，但仍是“尽力而为”的提升。

• kryogen1c：认为缓存的本地凭据和保存的远程桌面协议（RDP）凭据长期存在，且可以通过组策略（GPO）设置进行管理。质疑讨论者是否在工作组环境中测试而非域环境，并指出如果时间过长，缓存的凭据将失效。

• gerdesj：对讨论内容持怀疑态度，认为RDP密码经过加密和加盐处理，除非在ADUC中勾选特定选项，否则不会以明文存储。质疑微软声明“设计决策确保至少一个用户账户始终能够登录”的真正含义。

• photon_rancher：确认在Windows AD登录中，若在脱机状态下更改密码，旧密码仍可使用。如果恢复网络连接，系统可能会接受旧密码，但输入错误密码会触发域检查，导致登录窗口挂起。虽然行为不理想，但可能在域设置中可配置。

• notnmeyer：认为这种行为是不可接受的，表示震惊和反对。

• politelemon：个人经验表明在企业域环境中无法利用这种行为，访问被拒绝。

• kryogen1c暗示讨论者可能在寻求bug bounty（漏洞赏金），并提到无缓存需要always-on VPN等设置。
• gerdesj提到自己主要使用Linux，对Windows中的此类问题感到厌烦。
• photon_rancher详细描述了在线和离线状态下密码验证的行为差异，并指出域同步速度慢可能导致登录体验差。

• 核心争议在于微软的离线凭据行为是否是一个设计缺陷，还是为了确保可用性的必要设计决策。有人认为这是不可接受的安全风险，而另一些人则认为在某些情况下这是必要的功能。

data.title: Show HN: Beatsync – perfect audio sync across multiple devices
data.author: freemanjiang
data.article_summary: Beatsync 是一个高精度的网页音频播放器，支持多设备同步播放和空间音频效果。其主要特点包括毫秒级同步精度、跨平台兼容（现代浏览器均可使用，Chrome 效果最佳）、空间音频控制及精美的用户界面。项目支持自托管，并提供了快速启动指南。目前处于早期开发阶段，移动端支持正在实验中。技术上使用 Turborepo 管理，包含 Bun 服务器、Next.js 前端和共享的 Type-safe 代码。项目代码基于 MIT 协议开源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：多设备音频同步技术的实现和应用

不同观点：
• whimsy认为该技术在家庭和聚会场景中都有很大的应用潜力。家庭应用中，可以通过服务器调整每个客户端的音频输出，以实现最佳音效，尤其是在多声道音响系统中。聚会场景中，希望设备能够自动定位并调整同步，实现移动中的音频同步，但这一点可能需要硬件支持。同时还提出了对铜缆和光缆延迟的考虑。
• freemanjiang强调该技术最初为面对面的群体聆听设计，但由于只需要浏览器即可工作，因此也可以跨互联网使用，让远距离的多人同步聆听同一音频。
• Krei-se建议使用RTP与PulseAudio结合，可以天然解决设备间的延迟同步问题，无需额外软件。
• daredoes提到Snapcast是当前用于全屋音频同步的解决方案，并愿意尝试其他替代方案。
• thruflo分享了其他类似的项目以供参考，如Strobe.audio和Panaudia。
• dchristian提醒注意专利问题，提到了Sonos和Google之间的音频同步技术争议。
• TowerTall分享了一个实际的历史例子，说明这种技术在过去可能带来的便利。
• Dwedit和fxtentacle关注音频缓冲区和设备时钟速率差异的处理问题。
• matteason表示对该技术在其自身项目中的应用感兴趣，并希望借鉴其中的技术。
• chaosprint提出了使用WebTransport的建议，并关注网络抖动和系统级音频输出延迟的差异对同步的影响。
• Groxx对该技术在不同设备和浏览器间的准确性表示赞赏。
• maxmynter95提到多设备播放时可能出现的轻微延迟，产生类似混响的效果。
• rezonant指出该项目尚未选定开源许可证，因此严格来说只是源码可见而非开源。
• lacoolj对该技术的潜力表示兴奋，但对目前仅优化特定平台表示失望，期待跨平台的改进。

补充讨论：
• 技术实现上，涉及了设备自动定位、音频缓冲区管理、时钟速率差异、网络抖动和系统延迟等问题。
• 应用场景包括家庭音响系统、聚会音频同步、跨互联网同步聆听等。
• 专利和开源许可证问题也被提及，显示出对法律和许可方面的关注。
• 不同用户对平台适用性和优化程度的反馈，表明了跨平台兼容性的重要性。

Beatsync
Beatsync is a high-precision web audio player built for multi-device playback. The official app is
beatsync.gg
.
beatsync-demo.mov
Features
Millisecond-accurate synchronization
: Abstracts
NTP-inspired
time synchronization primitives to achieve a high degree of accuracy
Cross-platform
: Works on any device with a modern browser (Chrome recommended for best performance)
Spatial audio:
Allows controlling device volumes through a virtual listening source for interesting sonic effects
Polished interface
: Smooth loading states, status indicators, and all UI elements come built-in
Self-hostable
: Run your own instance with a few commands
Note
Beatsync is in early development. Mobile support is working, but experimental. Please consider creating an issue or contributing with a PR if you run into problems!
Quickstart
This project uses
Turborepo
.
Fill in the
.env
file in
apps/client
with the following:
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8080
NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://localhost:8080/ws
Run the following commands to start the server and client:
bun install

installs once for all workspaces
bun dev

starts both client (:3000) and server (:8080)

data.article_summary: 乌克兰正在利用18世纪的技术——飞艇，来增强其防御能力，尤其是在对抗无人机方面。这些飞艇配备了现代传感器和摄像设备，能够有效监测和干扰敌方无人机。由于飞艇具有滞空时间长、覆盖范围广的优势，它们为乌克兰提供了持续的空中监视能力，提升了反无人机作战的效率。这一创新结合了古老技术与现代科技，展示了在当前冲突中的独特应用价值。文章由专注于航空航天和国防技术的记者Tereza Pultarova撰写。

data.title: We need more optimistic science fiction
data.author: craig552uk
data.article_summary: 文章呼吁更多乐观的科幻作品，认为科幻曾推动人类想象和创造更美好的未来，如20世纪中期的太空竞赛。然而，如今的科幻多聚焦于反乌托邦和末世景象，与现实愈发接近，导致人们对未来失去乐观期待。作者引用托尔金和弗里德曼的观点，强调科幻不应仅是逃避现实的工具，更应是道德责任，帮助人们想象不同的、更好的世界，并提前提出新想法以应对未来危机。作者鼓励从悲观转向乐观，重新激发对美好未来的希望和雄心，通过科幻探索可能的未来，使不可能变为必然。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：科幻作品的乐观与悲观前景，科技对人类社会的影响，以及当前社会问题在科幻中的反映。

不同观点：
• **AIPedant** 引述 Colin Fraser 的观点，认为《黑镜》过于乐观，因为其中的科技虽然邪恶但至少有效。而真正的悲观科幻应展示无用的科技，例如愚蠢的人工智能、无法行走的机器人等。
• **ferguess_k** 期待一个科技解放人类的世界，人们不再为基本生存需求牺牲好奇心，社会更关注预防疾病，公民勇于发声，社会不再以金钱利润为成功指标。
• **snowwrestler** 认为乐观的科幻应展示如何从当前社会问题走向理想未来，强调社会进步需要文化、善良和同理心，而非仅依赖科技。
• **wirdnok** 引用Jerry Holkins的观点，认为当前文化过度解构事物，需要重新创造有抱负的内容以便将来解构。
• **marc_abonce** 引用Ursula K. Le Guin的观点，指出人们对幸福的智力低估和对痛苦的过度关注，并认为Le Guin的作品促使人们想象不同的社会组织方式。
• **libraryofbabel** 指出讨论乐观科幻未提及Iain M. Banks的《The Culture》系列是一大缺失。
• **Animats** 分析当前技术趋势，如能源、AI和机器人技术，并提出如何构建适应这些变化的社会问题。
• **gmuslera** 认为现代科幻难以描绘乐观前景，因为现实中的文化复杂性和当前问题使得诸如外星拯救或星际旅行的设想不再可信。
• **lif** 提出科幻作品过度乐观，忽视了物理定律的限制，并推荐了一些不那么乐观的作品，如Kim Stanley Robinson的《Aurora》。
• **nottorp** 引用Philip Dick的作品，认为其对未来支付系统的预测是悲观但准确的。
• **JPLeRouzic** 认为21世纪的科幻小说较20世纪末更加怪诞和悲伤，反映出一种现代编辑选择。
• **Arn_Thor** 认为许多太空歌剧小说展示了一个比当前社会更进步的未来，即使不完美也属乐观。
• **NoSalt** 批评新的《星际迷航》电影和电视剧失去了旧作的乐观精神，更加悲观。
• **EdwardCoffin** 提到Neal Stephenson的Project Hieroglyph本应促进更乐观的科幻创作。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：乐观与悲观科幻的定义和表现方式，以及当前社会是否能通过科技实现理想未来。
• **重要论据**：引用具体作品和作者，如Le Guin、Philip Dick、Iain M. Banks等，支持各自的观点。
• **讨论关系**：许多评论相互回应或补充，如对乐观科幻需要文化进步的强调，以及对当前技术趋势和社会问题的分析。

43814724.article_content:
We Need More Optimistic Science Fiction
24 October 2024
essays
As a genre, science fiction has a proud heritage of shaping the future. We find it entertaining to imagine what the world
could
be like. Science fiction enables us to explore possible futures, and through exploring them, decide for ourselves what future we want to create.
For example, the space-race of the 1950's and 60's, was driven by a spirit of optimism and excitement for humanity breaking free of the Earth to explore the solar system and beyond. While the influence of the Cold War cannot be understated, it was science fiction that inspired us. Through science fiction we imagined a future where space travel was possible, and this drove us to make it a reality.
We imagined a better future. We wanted it, and we created it.
I feel we have lost this.
Science fiction has become dominated by dystopian and apocalyptic visions of the future, which for a time was entertaining. For a time, it
was
fun to imagine climate catastrophes, pandemics, authoritarian governments, economic collapse...
I think you can see where I'm going with this.
Reality is catching up with fiction. Cautionary tales have become our lived experiences. These worlds, into which we escaped for entertainment, now feel too close to our everyday lives. Consequently, we are less excited by our future, and expect less from it.
This is not a new thought. Other people, much smarter than I
have made this observation before
,
and made it better
. So I won't labour the point.
I want to focus on what we can do next.
We are losing our optimism for the future, and I think that science fiction has a responsibility to help bring it back. We do not need to be trapped in feelings of hopelessness. Through science fiction we can escape.
Escaping Together
Fantasy is escapist, and that is its glory. If a soldier is imprisoned by the enemy, don't we consider it his duty to escape?. . .If we value the freedom of mind and soul, if we're partisans of liberty, then it's our plain duty to escape, and to take as many people with us as we can!
― J.R.R. Tolkien
Science fiction and fantasy provide escapism, they allow us visit other worlds, different from our own. Ordinarily escapism is fleeting, a temporary respite from our ordinary lives into an exceptional fantasy. But Tolkien understood escapism to be more than this.
He believed that escapism was a duty, a moral obligation to escape from the tyranny of the mundane. To free our minds from the constraints of our lived experiences to imagine a different and better world.
I believe that science fiction has a duty to help us to escape from a perceived future of hopelessness. To break out of a pessimistic view of our world, and to show us paths to making life better for all.
It is wrong to believe that science fiction is just a playground for unrealistic fantasies. Science fiction is a tool for exploring the possible, for imagining the future. It can change the world.
It has done this before, it will do this again.
If we broaden our imaginations, explore the possibilities together then fantasy can become reality. Impossible can become inevitable.
From Impossible to Inevitable
Only a crisis - actual or perceived - produces real change. When that crisis occurs, the actions that are taken depend on the ideas that are laying around. That, I believe, is our basic function: to develop alternatives to existing policies, to keep them alive and available until the politically impossible becomes the politically inevitable.
― Milton Friedman
Friedman was an economist, political philosopher and Nobel laureate. He was a key figure in the development of the Chicago School of Economics, who's ideas became very influential in the 1970's and 80's, particularly with the Regan and Thatcher governments in the USA and UK.
I am not a fan of Milton Friedman, his politics and mine have little in common. But he did understand that for new ideas to be realised, they must become established long before they are needed. If we wait for crises to occur before we start thinking about solutions, we are already too late.
I believe that a lack of alternatives to our current political and economic ideas is a problem for the world right now. The crises in our current political and economic systems are obvious, we feel them every day. But our leaders (of all political colours) are stuck in the same old ideologies, repeating the same mistakes - we need new ideas.
While there are new ideas out there, sometimes even good ideas, these are not yet well established enough to be seen as politically viable. In Friedman's terms, there are no
politically inevitable alternatives laying around
.
Your politics is your own, and I'm not advocating any one idea over another here. What I am encouraging is a shift away from doom and gloom, towards optimism for our future. To get back the hope we once felt and a culture of ambition for a better world.
Science fiction can help by suggesting, exploring, promoting and est
43814724.article_summary: 文章呼吁更多乐观的科幻作品，认为科幻曾推动人类想象和创造更美好的未来，如20世纪中期的太空竞赛。然而，如今的科幻多聚焦于反乌托邦和末世景象，与现实愈发接近，导致人们对未来失去乐观期待。作者引用托尔金和弗里德曼的观点，强调科幻不应仅是逃避现实的工具，更应是道德责任，帮助人们想象不同的、更好的世界，并提前提出新想法以应对未来危机。作者鼓励从悲观转向乐观，重新激发对美好未来的希望和雄心，通过科幻探索可能的未来，使不可能变为必然。
43814724.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：科幻作品的乐观与悲观前景，科技对人类社会的影响，以及当前社会问题在科幻中的反映。

不同观点：
• **AIPedant** 引述 Colin Fraser 的观点，认为《黑镜》过于乐观，因为其中的科技虽然邪恶但至少有效。而真正的悲观科幻应展示无用的科技，例如愚蠢的人工智能、无法行走的机器人等。
• **ferguess_k** 期待一个科技解放人类的世界，人们不再为基本生存需求牺牲好奇心，社会更关注预防疾病，公民勇于发声，社会不再以金钱利润为成功指标。
• **snowwrestler** 认为乐观的科幻应展示如何从当前社会问题走向理想未来，强调社会进步需要文化、善良和同理心，而非仅依赖科技。
• **wirdnok** 引用Jerry Holkins的观点，认为当前文化过度解构事物，需要重新创造有抱负的内容以便将来解构。
• **marc_abonce** 引用Ursula K. Le Guin的观点，指出人们对幸福的智力低估和对痛苦的过度关注，并认为Le Guin的作品促使人们想象不同的社会组织方式。
• **libraryofbabel** 指出讨论乐观科幻未提及Iain M. Banks的《The Culture》系列是一大缺失。
• **Animats** 分析当前技术趋势，如能源、AI和机器人技术，并提出如何构建适应这些变化的社会问题。
• **gmuslera** 认为现代科幻难以描绘乐观前景，因为现实中的文化复杂性和当前问题使得诸如外星拯救或星际旅行的设想不再可信。
• **lif** 提出科幻作品过度乐观，忽视了物理定律的限制，并推荐了一些不那么乐观的作品，如Kim Stanley Robinson的《Aurora》。
• **nottorp** 引用Philip Dick的作品，认为其对未来支付系统的预测是悲观但准确的。
• **JPLeRouzic** 认为21世纪的科幻小说较20世纪末更加怪诞和悲伤，反映出一种现代编辑选择。
• **Arn_Thor** 认为许多太空歌剧小说展示了一个比当前社会更进步的未来，即使不完美也属乐观。
• **NoSalt** 批评新的《星际迷航》电影和电视剧失去了旧作的乐观精神，更加悲观。
• **EdwardCoffin** 提到Neal Stephenson的Project Hieroglyph本应促进更乐观的科幻创作。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：乐观与悲观科幻的定义和表现方式，以及当前社会是否能通过科技实现理想未来。

• **讨论关系**：许多评论相互回应或补充，如对乐观科幻需要文化进步的强调，以及对当前技术趋势和社会问题的分析。

data.title: Only Teslas exempt from new auto tariffs thanks to 85% domestic content rule
data.author: abduhl
data.article_summary: Waymo与丰田达成合作，计划在2025年4月30日前探索向消费者销售自动驾驶汽车的可能性。此前，Alphabet首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊在财报电话会议上提到的“未来可选性”引发了猜测。此次合作标志着Waymo迈出了关键一步，可能将其自动驾驶技术推向大众市场，而不仅限于目前的无人出租车服务。这将为消费者提供购买具备自动驾驶功能的私人车辆的机会，进一步推动自动驾驶技术的普及和发展。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：美国汽车制造业的国内含量要求及其影响，特别是特斯拉是否符合高国内含量要求以及相关关税政策的效果。

不同观点：
• AlotOfReading认为，即使是特斯拉也不能明确满足85%的国内含量要求。他指出NHTSA的数据显示特斯拉的国内含量不超过75%，并提到不同政府部门对"国内"的定义不同。他还担心关税政策可能导致更多汽车制造转移到亚洲。
• tritipsocial澄清关税计算公式，指出关税是按国内含量比例线性增加的，而不是在85%以下突然增加。他认为这种方法可以逐步激励企业提高国内生产比例。
• HarHarVeryFunny质疑该政策是否真正激励了国内制造，认为它更像是对已经达标企业的奖励，而不是对需要改变行为的企业进行激励。他还提出政策应更多关注高科技行业而非低端制造业。
• Aloisius提供了特斯拉车型的具体国内含量数据，显示特斯拉车型国内含量在65%到75%之间，并暗示计算方法可能不同。
• cosmicgadget对通过关税应对芬太尼危机的合理性提出质疑。
• guywithahat猜测特斯拉没有工会可能使其更容易在美国集中生产。
• socalgal2认为关税政策的目标是促进国内生产，并指出任何公司都可以达到85%的国内含量要求。
• Aloisius还担心政策的稳定性，认为当前政府的决策不够稳定。
• ChicagoDave认为关税政策不会改变消费者的购买选择，因为很多人无论如何都不会购买特斯拉。
• bgwalter提到一位支持特斯拉的商业人物，暗示市场对特斯拉的看好。
• AngryData质疑特斯拉的电池主要来自中国和日本，认为特斯拉不符合高国内含量要求，并暗示存在腐败。
• rectang对“自由市场”支持者的真实动机表示不信任，认为他们掌权时会偏袒自己人。
• asdsadasdasd123对文章内容和特斯拉关税问题感到困惑。
• otikik讽刺当前政策正在加速国家走向"香蕉共和国"（意指政治经济不稳定）。
• gehwartzen对国内成分的定义单位提出疑问，例如螺丝和挡风玻璃是否按相同标准计算，以及是按重量还是成本计算。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到特斯拉的国内含量是否足够高，以及关税政策是否能有效促进国内制造业回流。
• 对政策细节如国内成分的计算标准和关税公式的准确理解存在争议。
• 有人对政策的政治动机和稳定性表示怀疑，并有人提出应更多关注高科技行业而非低端制造。

data.title: How to build Intrinsic Motivation: a review of the science
data.author: buzzmerchant
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：内在动机（intrinsic motivation）的体验、成因、培养方式及相关讨论

不同观点：
• **sheepolog**：内在动机是一种强烈的专注和动力状态，伴随着自信和使命感。这种状态非常罕见，通常出现在重大生活事件期间。希望未来能有更多研究帮助人为触发这种状态。
• **buzzmerchant**：年轻时经常体验到内在动机，但随着年龄增长，这种体验减少。进行了大量研究以理解内在动机的成因，并希望能够培养它。
• **mettamage**：支持自我决定理论（SDT），并结合HEXACO人格理论。提出一些实用技巧，如重新定义任务叙事和利用音乐进入专注状态。强调身体健康对内在动机的影响。
• **nuancebydefault**：动机本身不应是目标，目标应是实现满足感。生活需要定期评估和反思，以调整方向。动机类似于关系，需要努力维持。
• **adiabatichottub**：强调与有共同兴趣和支持能力的人相处的重要性，以增强内在动机。
• **javier_e06**：通过视频游戏如Minecraft和Baba is You等探讨自我动机的培养，强调大脑可塑性的保持。
• **neogodless**：提到Daniel H. Pink的《Drive》一书，指出内在动机的成因和阻碍因素。
• **ChaitanyaSai**：探讨SDT与意识科学之间的联系，提出意识是自我构建的共识机制，并讨论如何在合成生物中发展这种机制。
• **GabriDaFirenze**：提到SDT研究在面对反对意见中的应用，并表示对分享经验的支持。
• **QuantumGood**：指出内在化/慢性羞耻感会削弱动机，有时需要先治愈内心。
• **begueradj**：认为动机是一种短暂的情绪状态。
• **spiderfarmer**：寻求抑制过度专注的方法，因为这种状态可能导致负面情绪。
• **Nevermark**：通过具体实验讨论奖励类型对阅读动机的影响，提出路径延续/启用奖励能增强自主性和能力感。分享了通过选择睡前故事书培养孩子阅读习惯的成功经验。

补充讨论：
• **内在动机的成因和维持**：不同评论者从心理学理论、个人经验和科学研究角度探讨了内在动机的成因和如何维持这种状态。
• **实用技巧和策略**：如重新定义任务叙事、利用音乐、选择奖励方式等具体方法被提出，以帮助培养和维持内在动机。
• **身体健康和情绪状态的影响**：强调身体健康和情绪状态对内在动机的影响，指出睡眠不足和负面情绪可能削弱动机。
• **自我构建和意识**：深入探讨意识和自我构建的机制，提出意识是自我构建的共识机制，并讨论如何在合成生物中发展这种机制。

争议焦点：
• **动机是否应作为目标**：有些评论者认为动机本身不应是目标，而应关注实现满足感和生活方向的调整。
• **内在动机的培养方式**：不同评论者提出了多种培养内在动机的方法，有些方法可能存在个体差异和适用条件。

Introduction
#
Today, we are excited to announce the release of
Qwen3
, the latest addition to the Qwen family of large language models. Our flagship model,
Qwen3-235B-A22B
, achieves competitive results in benchmark evaluations of coding, math, general capabilities, etc., when compared to other top-tier models such as DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3, and Gemini-2.5-Pro. Additionally, the small MoE model,

We are open-weighting two MoE models:

chat.qwen.ai
) and mobile APP!
Key Features
#
Hybrid Thinking Modes
Qwen3 models introduce a hybrid approach to problem-solving. They support two modes:
Thinking Mode: In this mode, the model takes time to reason step by step before delivering the final answer. This is ideal for complex problems that require deeper thought.
Non-Thinking Mode: Here, the model provides quick, near-instant responses, suitable for simpler questions where speed is more important than depth.
This flexibility allows users to control how much “thinking” the model performs based on the task at hand. For example, harder problems can be tackled with extended reasoning, while easier ones can be answered directly without delay. Crucially, the integration of these two modes greatly enhances the model’s ability to implement stable and efficient thinking budget control. As demonstrated above, Qwen3 exhibits scalable and smooth performance improvements that are directly correlated with the computational reasoning budget allocated. This design enables users to configure task-specific budgets with greater ease, achieving a more optimal balance between cost efficiency and inference quality.
Multilingual Support
Qwen3 models are supporting
119 languages and dialects
. This extensive multilingual capability opens up new possibilities for international applications, enabling users worldwide to benefit from the power of these models.

data.article_summary: 文章主要提倡在项目规划阶段采取“建设性悲观”态度，提前预见潜在问题。通过进行“事前验尸”，设想项目可能出错的地方，如实施中的未知风险、对其他团队的依赖或项目范围的变更等。文章建议不要盲目乐观，而是尽早提出这些问题，并花时间制定应对策略，以避免未来被问题打乱节奏。关键在于不仅要发现问题，还要积极寻找解决方案，避免无谓的消极。这种做法有助于更顺利地推进项目，避免意外障碍。

43850929.article_content:
Don't Break Prod
Be Productively Pessimistic
The earlier you can catch problems, the better. So why not try to catch them before they even happen.
When talking through plans for a project, take some time to be pessimistic. Think about what can go wrong. Are there unknowns in the implementation that could prove to be big time sinks or high risk? Are there dependencies on other teams that could fall through? Is it likely that someone will make major changes in shape or scope while the project is in progress?
Imagine something went wrong with the project and try to predict what caused it (this is sometimes called a "premortem"). It's better to bring these up early than to pretend that everything will probably be ok. The "productive" part of being productively pessimistic is then taking some time to work out ways to handle these potential problems.
Don't just be needlessly negative about things, but don't let yourself be blindsided by problems you could get ahead of with a little pessimism.

data.title: Microsoft Confirms $1.50 Windows Security Update Hotpatch Fee Starts July 1
data.author: ok123456
data.article_summary: 微软宣布从2025年7月1日起，对Windows Server 2025用户收取每月1.50美元的"热补丁"安全更新费用。热补丁功能允许在不重启系统的情况下应用安全更新，特别适合需要高可用性的服务器环境。该功能此前在预览阶段免费，但从7月1日起，Windows Server 2025标准版和数据中心版的用户若要使用热补丁，需按每个CPU核心1.50美元的价格订阅该服务，且服务器需连接到Azure Arc。虽然每年仍需重启服务器四次以进行基础更新，但热补丁能减少传统补丁日带来的不便。该服务为可选项，主要针对需要减少停机时间和提高安全性的企业用户。此外，微软还提供了如何为不再获得安全支持的旧版Windows系统获取安全更新的方法。

Update, April 30, 2025: This story, originally published April 28, has been updated with further information regarding the hotpatching security update service for Windows Server 2025 users, as well as news of how to get security updates for legacy Windows operating systems that no longer have security support or patches available from Microsoft. .
When it comes to
security updates
, those that fix vulnerabilities in an operating system used by billions are high on the mandatory agenda. Which is why it has not been the greatest month for Microsoft, what with the online furor after a recent Windows security patch added a mysterious folder, without any explanation. Social media “experts” advised users to delete it, only for Microsoft to
issue an advisory warning
that would leave them open to attack. That update, and the installation of the inetpub folder, has now been shown to actually open the path to a different
Windows hack attack
. Now the whole Windows security update business has another contentious issue to deal with: charging a monthly subscription to receive no-reboot security “hotpatch” updates.
Forbes
Microsoft Confirms Password Spraying Attack — What You Need To Know
By
Davey Winder
What Is Windows Hotpatching?
As I reported April 14, Microsoft is moving toward a time whereby a hotpatching function would negate the need to reboot your Windows system following a security update. The
no-reboot security fixes
would download and install in the background, deployed within the in-memory code of already running processes. That report was concerning the feature coming to users of a very specific version of Windows 11: Windows 11 Enterprise, version 24H2 for x64 (AMD/Intel) CPU device users running Microsoft Intune for deployment. Now, Janine Patrick, Windows Server product marketing manager, and Artem Pronichkin, a senior program manager at Microsoft, have confirmed that the hotpatch system for Windows Server 2025, comes out of preview mode on July 1.
Microsoft has said that hotpatching brings a number of important benefits to the security update process. Not least that there will be higher availability with fewer reboots required, and that’s no bad thing in anyone’s book. Updates will be faster to deploy as they will arrive in much smaller packages that install quickly and, Microsoft pointed out, have easier patch orchestration with the optional Azure Update Manager. Finally, and most important as far as I am concerned, is the fact that because there is no rebooting required, the windows of vulnerability, that period between a vulnerability becoming known and getting patched, so leaving it open to exploit by attackers, closes sooner. This is particularly of note, Microsoft said, “if an administrator might normally delay an update and restart after a Windows security update is released.”

Microsoft has said that the Windows Server 2025 hotpatching feature, which has been available in preview mode since 2024, will become a subscription-only service from July 1. So, who has to pay the fee?
Well, first things first, to be able to run the no-reboot hotpatch security updates feature,
Microsoft said
that you will need to be using “Windows Server 2025 Standard or Datacenter, and your server must be connected to Azure Arc.” The important and controversial bit quickly followed: “You will also need to subscribe to the Hotpatch service.”
Although hotpatching has been available for the longest time for Windows Server Datacenter: Azure Edition, and it will continue without charge, these security updates for Windows Server 2025 users will cost $1.50 per CPU core per month. Yes, you read that right, per core.
“With hotpatching,” Microsoft said, “you will still need to restart your Windows Servers about four times yearly for baseline updates, but hotpatching can save significant time and ease the inconvenience of a traditional Patch Tuesday.” Only you can decide if it is for you, and the service is entirely optional.

data.article_summary: ROSplat是一个基于ROS2的在线高斯散点可视化工具，能够实时渲染数百万个高斯点，支持从PLY文件加载数据并集成ROS2工具如bag录制。它使用自定义的ROS2消息类型（SingleGaussian和GaussianArray）来封装高斯点的属性，并通过GPU加速排序和渲染。该项目在Ubuntu 24.04 LTS和ROS2 Jazzy上开发和测试，建议使用NVIDIA显卡以获得最佳性能。依赖项包括ROS2和可选的GPU库如cupy和torch。项目还提供了Docker设置选项，并包含详细的安装和使用说明。贡献和反馈欢迎联系作者。

• [jimmySixDOF] 提出了一种具体的应用场景：首先上传预先处理好的地面状态GSplat，经过校准后，使用Gaussian Splatting来反映空间位置信息，而不是或同时使用实际的摄像头反馈。他还讨论了在ROS设备上通过有限的摄像头姿态生成Splats的可能性。此外，他建议将Gaussian Splatting技术与VR头戴设备结合，以实现空间最小地图、分离视点等功能，从而创造更多实际应用机会。

ROSplat
The Online ROS2-Based Gaussian Splatting-Enabled Visualizer
Shady Gmira
Overview
ROSplat is the first online ROS2-based visualizer that leverages Gaussian splatting to render complex 3D scenes. It is designed to efficiently visualize millions of gaussians by using custom ROS2 messages and GPU-accelerated sorting and rendering techniques. ROSplat also supports data loading from PLY files and integrates with ROS2 tools such as bag recording.
Features
Real-Time Visualization:
Render millions of Gaussian “splats” in real time.
ROS2 Integration:
Built on ROS2 for online data exchange of Gaussians, Images, and IMU data.
Custom Gaussian Messages:
Uses custom message types (
SingleGaussian
and
GaussianArray
) to encapsulate properties such as position, rotation, scale, opacity, and spherical harmonics.
GPU-Accelerated Sorting & Rendering:
Offloads sorting and rendering tasks to the GPU.
Setup
This project was developed and tested on
Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
using
ROS2 Jazzy
.
Please note:
Performance degrades significantly without an NVIDIA graphics card.
Dependencies
Mandatory:
ROS2 (tested on ROS2 Jazzy)
Optional (for GPU-based Sorting):
cupy
(ensure compatibility with your CUDA version)
torch
(if using PyTorch for GPU sorting)
To install the optional GPU-based libraries individually:
pip install cupy-cuda12x  # Install Cupy (replace 12x with your CUDA version)
pip install torch         # Install PyTorch
The program will automatically prioritize sorting methods in the following order:
1) Torch → 2) Cupy → 3) CPU
To install all dependencies at once:
pip install -r requirements.txt        # For GPU acceleration
pip install -r requirements-no-gpu.txt  # Without GPU acceleration
Docker-Based Setup
Alternatively, you can set up the project using Docker. A setup script is available under the
docker
directory.
Before running Docker, ensure you have installed:
sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit
This enables GPU communication between the host and the container. If you come accross any other issues, follow the instructions under
the following link
Then, to build and run the Docker container:
cd docker
./run_docker.sh -h    # Display help and usage instructions
./run_docker.sh -bu   # Build the Docker image and launch the container with docker-compose
Important:
Ensure the host machine's CUDA version matches the version specified in the Dockerfile.
If you are using a CUDA version other than 12.6, update the Dockerfile accordingly.
Building the Gaussian Messages
ROSplat defines two custom ROS2 messages to handle Gaussian data, located in the
gaussian_interface/msg
folder.
Note:
The Gaussian messages are based on the
original Gaussian Splatting implementation by graphdeco-inria
.
Message Definitions
1. SingleGaussian.msg
geometry_msgs/msg/Point xyz
geometry_msgs/msg/Quaternion rotation
float32 opacity
geometry_msgs/msg/Vector3 scale
float32[] spherical_harmonics
2. GaussianArray.msg
gaussian_interface/SingleGaussian[] gaussians
Building the Messages
a) Build your workspace using colcon:
colcon build --packages-select gaussian_interface
b) Source your workspace:
. install/setup.bash
Important:
Depending on your shell, you might need to adjust these commands.
Usage
Once the Gaussian messages are built, you can launch the visualizer from the project's root directory:
cd src
python3 main.py
Contributions
Contributions and feedback are welcome!
Acknowledgments
I'm glad to have worked on such a challenging topic and grateful for the invaluable advice and support I received throughout this project.
Special thanks to
Qihao Yuan
and
Kailai Li
for their guidance and encouragement as well as the constructive feedback that helped shape this work.
This project was additionally influenced by
limacv
's implementation of the
GaussianSplattingViewer
repository.
Contact
For questions or further information, please email:
shady.gmira[at]gmail.com

data.title: Milwaukee police considering trading mugshots for facial recognition tech
data.author: Teever
data.article_summary: 密尔沃基警察局正考虑用250万张入案照片换取面部识别技术的使用权。警方称，此举将提高破案率和速度，但不会单独用于确定 probable cause（合理依据）。然而，活动人士和居民担心隐私和监控问题，尤其是联邦机构可能获取这些数据。警察局长助理Heather Hough表示，透明度优先于技术获取，尚未达成协议。尽管警方强调该技术不会单独导致逮捕，并计划制定相关政策，但公众和一些官员仍持怀疑态度，担心技术偏见及公民自由受侵。新任警察委员会委员Krissie Fung也对在当前政治环境下采用该技术表示担忧。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于警方和公众获取和使用嫌犯照片（mugshot）的法律和隐私问题

不同观点：
• **jjeaff** 认为应通过国家法律要求，如果在一定时间内未定罪，应永久删除嫌犯的照片，质疑未被定罪的无辜者照片被存档和分享的比例。
• **sparrish** 指出，嫌犯照片通常已经是公开的，只是现在更容易获取，似乎接受这种公开性。
• **fiduciarytemp** 提出技术性解决方案，建议使用同态加密技术提取面部特征，并进行加密面部搜索，以平衡隐私和公共安全需求。
• **juliusdavies** 质疑警方是否已经通过驾照照片数据库掌握了大多数人的面部信息，暗示即便没有嫌犯照片，普通公民的面部信息也可能早已被警方掌握。
• **zx8080** 将讨论引向极端，质疑这是否是美国首个全面监控提议，表现出对隐私全面暴露的担忧。
• **catlikesshrimp** 关注法律上对面部照片和相关元数据的永久所有权问题，以及面部识别技术的使用授权、价格和限制，强调潜在的法律和经济问题。
• **glaucon** 引用了“密尔沃基警察考虑交易”这一具体事件，暗示讨论的建议可能已经在某些地区被考虑或实施。
• **astrea** 提到PCSO面部识别数据集，暗示执法部门早已广泛使用面部识别技术。
• **spamjavalin** 简单表示支持该交易，似乎认为这是一个合理的做法。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于公众知情权与个人隐私权之间的平衡。一部分人关注未被定罪者的隐私保护（jjeaff, zx8080），另一部分人则接受嫌犯照片的公开性，甚至认为警方已经掌握了广泛的面部信息（juliusdavies, astrea）。
• 技术解决方案（fiduciarytemp）提供了一种可能的折中路径，但其可行性和实施细节仍待讨论。
• 讨论还涉及到法律和经济问题，如面部照片的所有权、使用授权和价格（catlikesshrimp）。

CRIME
Milwaukee police consider trade: 2.5 million mugshots for free facial recognition access
David Clarey
Milwaukee Journal Sentinel
Milwaukee Police Department is proposing trading 2.5 million jail records for facial recognition technology access with the company Biometrica.
Police say acquiring the technology will lead to higher clearance rate of cases and improve the speed at which crimes are solved. Officials say it will not be used alone to establish probable cause.
Activists and residents have concerns over the impact to privacy and add to growing surveillance tech in the city. Some are concerned how federal agencies could access it as well.
Milwaukee police are mulling a trade: 2.5 million mugshots for free use of facial recognition technology.
Officials from the Milwaukee Police Department say swapping the photos with the software firm Biometrica will lead to quicker arrests and solving of crimes. But that benefit is unpersuasive for those who say the trade is startling, due to the concerns of the surveillance of city residents and possible federal agency access.
"We recognize the very delicate balance between advancement in technology and ensuring we as a department do not violate the rights of all of those in this diverse community," Milwaukee Police Chief of Staff Heather Hough said during an April 17 meeting.
For the first time, Milwaukee police officials detailed their plans to use the facial recognition technology during a meeting of the city's Fire and Police Commission, the oversight body for those departments. In the past, the department relied on facial recognition technology belonging to neighboring police agencies
In an April 24 email, Hough said the department has not entered into an agreement with any facial recognition and the department intends to continue engaging the public before doing so. The department will discuss it at a future meeting of the city's Public Safety and Health Committee next, she said.
"While we would like to acquire the technology to assist in solving cases, being transparent with the community that we serve far outweighs the urgency to acquire," she said in an email.
Officials said the technology alone could not be used as probable cause to arrest someone and the only authorized uses would be when there's basis to believe criminal activity has happened or could happen, or a threat to public safety is imminent.
Hough said the department intended to craft a policy that would ensure no one is arrested solely based on facial recognition matches.
That reassurance and others from police officials came as activists, residents and some public officials voiced concern.
Concerns ranged from studies which show bias in the technology; its potential use by federal agencies like Immigration Customs Enforcement; and infringement on civil liberties. Many speakers noted cities,
including Madison
, have banned facial recognition's use by city agencies.
Aurelia Ceja said the discrepancy in the information police release on themselves — noting that officers involved in shootings don't have their names released — compared to the amount of information the police have on residents is a concern.
"First and foremost, (I'm) inherently against any sort of surveillance technology used by the police" said Ceja, a member of the
Milwaukee Alliance Against Racist and Political Repression
in an interview with the Journal Sentinel.
At the meeting, officials shared how the technology had been used in recent cases — a homicide and a sexual assault — to assist in identifying suspects. In both cases, police ran photos of men ultimately charged in the crimes through facial recognition technology to help identify them. Those identifications were then confirmed during the investigation, police said.
The company the department is exploring working with is Biometrica, a company which began with working in the
gambling industry in the late '90s.
The police presentation said it does not retain data, such as photos of possible suspects, which the police put into its system to check for matches. In exchange for the initial 2.5 million jail records, the company is offering two free search licenses, with any additional licenses costing $12,000 each.
Biometrica did not respond to a request for comment.
Fire and Police Commissioner Krissie Fung, who was recently appointed to the oversight body, said in an interview she was unconvinced by the proposal to use the technology at this time. Use of facial recognition should be determined by residents, she said.
Fung, like other speakers at the meeting, were concerned with adopting the technology in the current political environment under President Donald Trump. She said the IRS agreeing to share data with Immigration Customs Enforcement as an example.
"I did not get the sense that there are clear protections against federal entities being able to access this facial recognition data either through MPD or the company they will use," she said.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对经典画作《戴珍珠耳环的女孩》的高清细节分析及其相关技术应用

不同观点：
• cgriswald认为画作细节在放大后显得不清晰，并由此联想到小说创作中让读者“自行填补空白”的技巧，类似于欣赏绘画时观众的脑补行为。
• lubujackson提到电影《Tim's Vermeer》，推测维米尔可能使用了光箱技术来达到其绘画中独特的光影效果，并对维米尔的技艺进行工程学上的探讨。
• koliber关注画作裂缝的细节，特别是边缘的颜色变化，质疑这是否由光线引起或实际存在，并寻求解释。
• lvl155提出利用AI技术分析经典画作的笔触并生成动画的构想，以还原画作从无到有的过程。
• geuis指出画作右眼及背景部分存在过度绘画的痕迹，推测可能是由于画作表层老化及紫外线照射导致颜色变化。
• Freak_NL虽然欣赏画作本身，但表达了对画作被滥用于商业产品（如垃圾桶、枕头等）的无奈，认为这影响了其艺术价值。

补充讨论：
• MaxRegret分享了Steve Mould关于显微镜技术捕捉绘画3D浮雕的视频链接，提供了技术背景。
• fscaramuzza回应lvl155的AI项目，提供了Google Arts & Culture上相关的绘画分解资源链接。
• perks_12和roflmaostc提供了与高清图像渲染相关的技术资源和公司链接，讨论了用于生成超大尺度图像的技术。
• djmips注意到画作左上角的签名，并分享了相关参考链接。
• CodeCompost回忆了在博物馆看到扫描设备时的意外发现，提到了具体设备类型（Solaris工作站）。
• eviks询问是否存在去除裂缝的更清晰修复版本，显示出对无损画质版本的兴趣。

争议焦点：
• 画作细节的清晰度以及是否应通过技术手段修复裂缝和老化问题，geuis与eviks的观点反映了对于保护和呈现原作真实状态的不同偏好。
• 画作在现代商业中的滥用问题，Freak_NL的观点引发了对艺术作品商业化的批判性思考。

data.title: Stockhausen: Sounds in Space
data.author: brudgers
data.article_summary:
《SONNTAG aus LICHT》是卡尔海因茨·施托克豪森的《LICHT》七部歌剧 cycle 的最后一部，主题为迈克尔和夏娃的“神秘结合”。全剧分为五部分，通过音乐、视觉、空间甚至嗅觉手段展现结合的主题，而非传统的戏剧结构。

**第一场：《LICHTER–WASSER (SONNTAGS-GRUSS)》**  
为女高音、男高音、管弦乐队及合成器创作。演出中，独唱者引导乐手在观众席间移动，点燃蜡烛，形成“光”的意象。乐手们传递旋律片段，制造出环绕观众厅的“音浪”。

**第二场：《ENGEL-PROZESSIONEN (天使游行)》**  
为无伴奏合唱。混声合唱团和七个天使合唱团在观众席间演唱多语言歌曲，象征从二元对立到统一的结合，最终汇聚成花山。

**第三场：《LICHT-BILDER (光之画)》**  
为男高音、小号、巴赛特单簧管和长笛演奏。通过逆序的主题片段和环形调制效果，展现音乐和空间的互动。

**第四场：《DÜFTE - ZEICHEN (气味 - 符号)》**  
为七位歌手和童声创作，庆祝每周七天的不同气味和符号。

全剧通过多感官体验，表现神秘结合的主题。

43852527.article_content:
Sunday from Light (1998-2003)
for 10 vocal soloists, boy’s voice, four instrumental soloists
(bassett horn, flute, trumpet, synthesizer), two choirs, two orchestras,
electronic music.
SONNTAG aus LICHT (Sunday From Light) is the 7th and final opera in Karlheinz Stockhausen's "7 day" LICHT (Light) opera cycle, following
MITTWOCH aus LICHT
. SONNTAG is characterized as the "Day of Mystical Union" between the LICHT protagonists MICHAEL and EVE. In the opening Scene of this 5-part production, an orchestra atomizes and rotates the themes of MICHAEL and
EVE, after which a procession of "Angels" praises their union. The scene "Light Pictures"
reflects the courtship between these two characters in a 3-way "shadow-play", and seven "Scents of the
Week" are celebrated. Finally, an orchestra and choir take turns
to finalize this union with "recollections" of scenes from each day of
LICHT. The scenes in SONNTAG do not have a dramatic arc connecting them,
instead the actual theme of union between the characters Michael and Eve are achieved
through musical, visual, spatial and even olfactory means.
Scene 1: LICHTER–WASSER (SONNTAGS-GRUSS)/(Light-Waters, or Sunday Greeting)
For soprano, tenor, and orchestra (29 pcs.) with synthesizer. Composed 1998-1999, premiered 1999 during the Donaueschinger Musiktage (Southwest German Radio).
After an introductory duet, the tenor and soprano soloists lead members of the orchestra to appointed locations situated throughout the audience seating area. After each player has reached his/her spot, a candle is lit (the "Light" of the title). During this opening ritual a complex harmony slowly builds from broad held figures. The main section of this Scene is characterized by short melodic fragments (based in the LICHT Michael and Eve melody themes) passed around by members of the orchestra in two layers. This results in "waves" of melodies circling around the audience hall in separate tempos. This structure is interrupted by several soloistic interludes, as well as a section where some musicians "ascend" to an elevated stage for a narrative scene. At the end, each player drinks from a bowl of water (the "Water" of the title) and depart.
Further Analysis and Listening Guide
Scene 2: ENGEL-PROZESSIONEN (Angel Processions)
For choir (a cappella). Composed 2000, premiered 2002 at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.
In ENGEL-PROZESSIONEN, the setting is a hall lined with a mixed choir along the rear and side walls (a "Tutti Choir"), singing slow, quiet tones and aleatoric syllables. Promenading through the audience are 7 singing "Angel Choirs" (choir groups of 4 to 6 singers) using texts from 7 different languages. A tenor and soprano lead the choir members in synchronized hand gestures. The 7th Angel Choir, the Angels of Joy, also sometimes sings from the balcony (echoing the "elevated" section of the 1st Scene). During this Scene, the 7 Angel Choirs sing in various vocal combinations (layered configurations of 2-part polyphony) while promenading in ritualistic fashion throughout the performance space. Since the theme of SONNTAG AUS LICHT is "mystical union", the polyphonic EVE and MICHAEL layers of each Angel Choir gradually meld together (Duality to unity) as the Scene progresses into a homophonic texture at the end, at which point each Angel Choir proceeds up the middle of the hall and converges, bringing irises and lilies to form a mountain of flowers.
Further Analysis and Listening Guide
Scene 3: LICHT-BILDER (Light Pictures)
For tenor vocalist, trumpet with ring-modulation, basset-horn, and flute/alto flute with ring-modulation. Composed 2002-2003, premiered 2004.
In this Scene the tenor vocalist and basset-horn soloist navigate through "backwards-ordered" fragments of the Michael and Eve themes. The trumpet and flute play staggered variations of the tenor and bassett-horn (effectively acting as rippling "reflections). The sounds of the trumpet and flute are also processed through a digital ring-modulation effect, which adds a further "warped reflection" to the musical texture (these sounds are projected from the rear of the hall). Throughout this performance the performers also move about the space in motions reflective of the musical material. Divided into 7 sections (one for each day of the week), the polyphonic texture of this Scene is broken up by several interludes based on harmonized duos, trios and quartets. The libretto sung by the tenor soloist is made up of non-grammatical words and phrases which praise God and correspond to the "essences of seven spheres of life".
Further Analysis and Listening Guide
Scene 4: DÜFTE - ZEICHEN (Scents - Signs)
For 7 vocalists, boy’s voice, synthesizer. Composed 2002, premiered 2003 at the Salzburg Festival.

data.author: JojoFatsani

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：铁路运输及其基础设施，特别是与皇后区相关的货运路线、铁路系统的国际比较及未来发展

不同观点：
• IIAOPSW 指出，实际上存在通往皇后区的铁路桥梁和隧道，例如Hells Gate桥和东河隧道，并解释了纽约及大西洋铁路公司如何接管长岛铁路的货运业务。他还提到了一种通过65号码头和贝永之间的浮动驳船操作，并认为将其称为“新终点站”有些误导。
• Animats 讨论了在混凝土中使用粉煤灰的技术优势，并提到粉煤灰的获取方式及其环境影响，引用了科学文献支持其观点。
• damnitbuilds 认为铁路是乘客旅行的未来，强调火车旅行的舒适性和观赏体验。
• Lammy 提到通过与当地短线铁路合作，避免了购买土地和与政府交涉的麻烦，从而更便捷地满足具体需求。
• paddy_m 对比瑞士与其他国家在货运铁路系统上的差异，特别关注其操作实践、电气化铁路的优势以及可能的补贴和税收政策。
• jmloop 批评一些国家为发展公路、公交和卡车而破坏铁路系统，认为这是一种遗憾的“进步”。
• jcranmer 澄清了关于皇后区货运隧道的现状，指出拟议中的跨港隧道项目进展缓慢，几乎没有实际行动。
• bux93 提到火车轨道和终点站的建设在美国的工厂中很常见，并列举了一些近年来的例子，主要涉及电动汽车和电池业务。
• mcfedr 认为只有美国人称火车为过时的事物。
• rsynnott 认为将新设施称为“新终点站”有些夸大。
• nashashmi 讨论了拟议中的货运隧道项目，并提出了对埃隆·马斯克式项目的看法，认为政府资助具有风险但值得一试。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是皇后区是否存在铁路桥梁或隧道，IIAOPSW 和 jcranmer 提供了不同的信息和解释。
• paddy_m 对瑞士铁路系统的成功表示关注，并希望了解其操作实践和政策支持的具体细节。
• 关于铁路的未来发展，mcfedr 和 nashashmi 提出了不同的文化视角和技术设想。

通过这些讨论，可以看出参与者对铁路运输的多方面关注，包括基础设施、技术应用、政策影响以及国际比较。

data.title: All four major web browsers are about to lose 80% of their funding
data.author: dfabulich
data.article_summary:
文章主要讨论了美国四大主流浏览器——Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Mozilla Firefox和Apple Safari——的资金来源问题。目前，Google通过支付巨额资金让Firefox和Safari默认使用其搜索引擎，分别为Mozilla每年支付约4.5亿美元，为Apple支付约180亿美元。这些资金占Mozilla收入的83%，并可能覆盖Safari大部分开发成本。此外，Microsoft Edge实质上是基于Google的Chromium项目，Google贡献了约94%的代码。

美国司法部（DoJ）正在试图迫使Google停止这些支付，并剥离Chrome，理由是反垄断。然而，这将导致所有主流浏览器的开发资金大幅减少，严重影响其持续发展，进而影响整个互联网生态。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Chromium浏览器及其主导地位的变化对浏览器生态的影响，以及反垄断法律对技术创新的潜在影响。

不同观点：
• **Abhisek的观点**：认为Google对Chromium的资助推动了浏览器安全和创新的进步，特别是浏览器核心组件如v8和Blink对现代网络的重要性。如果反垄断法迫使Google放弃对Chromium的控制，可能会破坏整个网络生态的稳定。

• **Sitkack的观点**：对Google大量资金投入导致浏览器复杂性增加持批评态度，认为这种资金驱动下的创新往往是过度复杂化的功能，而非用户真正需要的改进。

• **Ggm的观点**：对浏览器创新速度过快持怀疑态度，认为大多数创新并没有实质性提升，反而增加了复杂性。相比之下，更关心CVE和漏洞修复的速度，而不是持续的创新。

• **Devsda的观点**：分析浏览器开发的不同方面（如新标准、新功能、UI/UX改进、漏洞和安全修复），认为如果Google不再主导Chrome的开发，其他浏览器将有机会在UI和用户体验上进行改进，而不是仅仅追赶Google的步伐。

• **Kace91的观点**：提到Google通过资助Mozilla和Safari制造虚假竞争环境是违法的，反垄断法的干预可能会打破这种不正常的现状，但也可能无意中破坏浏览器生态的稳定。

• **Bl4kers的观点**：认为生态系统已经被Google的资金投入破坏，微软和苹果没有尽到自己的责任，反而伤害了消费者。

• **Thayne的观点**：认为当前的状况需要改变，但切断关键项目的资金而没有替代计划是不负责任的。

• **Ec109685的观点**：反对过度担忧，认为即使Google不再资助Chrome，其他公司也会有动力继续投资。同时指出，无论是Google还是Apple，都未能让浏览器应用体验媲美原生应用。

• **Errantmind的观点**：支持让Mozilla重新专注于用户，认为过多的免费资金会让组织迷失方向，希望Mozilla能回归用户支持的模式。

• **Fguerraz的观点**：认为浏览器开发者应该重新将用户视为客户，而不是产品，支持用户为浏览器付费以获得尊重和更好的服务。

• **Bigomega的观点**：希望更多第三方非科技巨头参与竞争，如Arc和Brave浏览器，以促进市场多样性。

• **Kjeldsendk的观点**：认为浏览器市场可能重新开放竞争，并提到OpenAI等公司可能会进入默认搜索引擎市场。

• **Parrit的观点**：希望Mozilla能从其他知识发现公司（如Anthropic或OpenAI）获得资金支持，以维持浏览器开发。

• **K_bx的观点**：对Mozilla通过Google搜索包装获取资金的未来可能性持怀疑态度。

• **Mediumsmart的观点**：质疑关于Safari每年需要180亿美元资助的说法，认为实际所需资金远低于此，并讽刺这种说法不切实际。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于Google对Chromium的控制及其对整个浏览器生态的影响，以及反垄断法干预可能带来的利弊。
- 部分讨论者对浏览器复杂性和过度创新表示不满，更关注安全和漏洞修复。
- 资金来源和商业模式是另一个讨论重点，特别是如何在Google减少投入的情况下维持浏览器开发。

43827054.article_content:
All four major web browsers are about to lose 80% of their funding
Google pays for 80%+ of the development budget of all major web browsers, and soon, the US will force Google to stop supporting their competitors.
Dan Fabulich
Follow
3 min read
·
2 days ago
--
Listen
Share
Four major web browsers dominate the market: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and Apple’s Safari. What most users don’t realize is that Google effectively bankrolls over 80% of the development for
all
of them. But this funding stream is under threat: the US Department of Justice is moving to force Google to cut off its competitors and divest from Chrome, a decision that will simultaneously cripple the development of every major browser.
Google directly pays 80%+ of Mozilla and Safari’s budget
Google pays Mozilla and Apple to make Google Search the default search engine for Firefox and Safari.
Google pays Apple about $18 billion each year
, and pays Mozilla about $450 million each year.
“In 2021 these payments accounted for 83% of Mozilla’s revenue.”
Apple doesn’t disclose how much they spend on Safari specifically, but
Apple’s total R&D across all its products (iPhones, Macs, etc.) was nearly $30 billion in 2023
. Google’s $18 billion payment specifically for search placement represents a staggering 60% of that total budget. The portion Apple spends just on Safari development is undoubtedly far smaller, meaning Google’s payment likely covers a vast majority of Safari’s specific development costs.
Microsoft Edge is just a Microsoft-branded version of Google Chrome
Microsoft Edge is actually a “white label” copy of Google Chrome
, specifically the open-source “Chromium” browser that Google maintains.
Now, to be fair, Microsoft isn’t
just
copying Chrome; they also contribute code back to Chromium. But Microsoft contributes much, much less than Google does.
“In 2024, Google made over 100,000 commits to Chromium, accounting for ~94 percent of contributions.”
Most of the funding for all of the major browsers is going away
The US Department of Justice has argued that Google should be forbidden from making search-engine deals with Mozilla and Apple.
Mozilla and Apple have argued against this.
Apple seeks to defend Google’s billion-dollar payments in search case
Mozilla: The DOJ’s proposal hurts, not helps, browser competition
And
the DoJ has also argued that Google should be forced to sell off Chrome
, forbidding Google from paying for Chrome and Chromium. Microsoft Edge will lose 94% of its funding when that happens.
Google’s probably going to lose, and the web will be in pretty big trouble when Google gets what’s coming to them
The DoJ’s argument against Google makes perfect sense. The Sherman Antitrust Act was specifically designed to target “competitors” who form illegal agreements to maintain monopoly power.
It’s
obviously
illegal for Google to prop up Mozilla Firefox and Apple Safari as if they were co-equal competitors to Chrome. And Chrome itself is the biggest “search-engine deal” of all, which is why the DoJ is so focused on forcing Google to divest from Chrome.
It just so happens that all four of the major web browsers will lose all of their funding all at once when that happens.
Forcing Google to stop funding its “competitors” and divest Chrome doesn’t just punish Google; it simultaneously pulls the financial rug out from under
every single major browser,
including those positioned as alternatives.
The laws intended to foster competition will inadvertently destabilize the foundational tools millions rely on to access the internet.

• [mrbonner] 分享了一个有趣的例子，展示了推理模型在处理单词"strrawberrry"中字母'r'的数量时的思考过程和错误结果。模型给出的答案是3个'r'，而实际应为5个，显示了模型推理过程中的不准确性。
• [gthompson512] 询问Phi模型在训练过程中是否仍然存在测试集问题，表明对模型训练状况的关注，特别是是否已修复相关问题。
• [behnamoh] 对微软的策略表示疑问，指出微软在拥有OpenAI和Mistral大量股份的同时，又发布了开放权重的模型，这种策略让人困惑。

data.title: The one interview question that will protect you from North Korean fake workers
data.author: dotcoma
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了如何识别和防范朝鲜 infiltrators 渗透西方公司的手段。这些 infiltrators 伪装成远程技术工人，通过生成式AI创建虚假身份，并在面试中使用不同团队处理技术挑战。一个简单而有效的面试问题是询问对朝鲜领导人金正恩的看法，通常会让 infiltrators 立即退出。这些假员工通过窃取知识产权和植入恶意软件获利，建议公司在面试中要求现场编程测试以验证身份。尽管 FBI 提供了识别指南，但这些 infiltrators 不断调整策略，包括在美国设立笔记本农场以掩盖IP地址。一旦暴露，他们会试图勒索公司，因此建议立即联系FBI。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：北韩假工人在科技行业中的面试和雇佣问题

不同观点：
• **北韩工人的技术能力与忠诚度**：ferguess_k提到北韩有专门针对天才儿童的教育项目，培养出技术能力很强的人。这些工人因高薪和热爱工作而对政府忠诚，但可能会面临职业倦怠问题。

• **面试过程中的识别问题**：lifthrasiir认为可以通过一些特殊问题（如要求骂领导人）来识别北韩工人，但这种方法不会持久。gossterrible分享了自己遇到的中国工人试图利用其Upwork账户的经历，通过调侃领导人迅速结束了对话。

• **历史类比与面试技巧**：WalterBright通过二战中德国 infiltrators 的例子，建议可以通过特定文化问题（如棒球）来识别 infiltrators。progbits则质疑为何这些北韩人不假装是韩国人，并提出阴谋论认为这些 infiltrators 是故意失败的。

• **面试过程的有效性与远程工作问题**：nottorp质疑文章中所描述的假工人是否真的存在，认为这反映了面试过程本身的问题。nyokodo建议恢复面对面面试以解决问题。Herring认为通过药物测试和背景调查可以解决这个问题，并建议避免雇佣全远程员工。

• **北韩人成功面试的原因**：iJohnDoe质疑北韩人如何成功通过面试和获得工作，认为这揭示了招聘系统的严重问题。

• **对领导人形象的调侃**：comrade1234和rdtsc都对北韩领导人的体型进行了调侃，rdtsc进一步讨论了这种调侃在北韩的可能接受程度。

• **防范措施与实际案例**：koliber分享了自己关于如何防范北韩假工人的经验，并提供了相关指南链接。

• **娱乐化与兴趣**：deadbabe建议将北韩假工人的生活和工作拍成Netflix剧集，表现出对这一话题的娱乐化兴趣。

补充讨论：
• **“笔记本电脑农场”概念的困惑**：stevage对“笔记本电脑农场”的运作方式表示不解，寻求更多解释。这涉及到有人在美国境内同意为费用运行笔记本电脑，以此掩盖非法活动的地址。

争议焦点：
• **面试过程中的文化与识别问题**：如何在不侵犯个人隐私和文化敏感性的前提下，有效识别潜在的北韩假工人，是讨论中的一个争议焦点。

43853382.article_content:
Spotlight on RSAC
77
The one interview question that will protect you from North Korean fake workers
77
FBI and others list how to spot NK infiltrators, but AI will make it harder
Iain Thomson
Tue 29 Apr 2025
//
09:15 UTC
RSAC
Concerned a new recruit might be a North Korean stooge out to steal intellectual property and then hit an org with malware? There is an answer, for the moment at least.
According to Adam Meyers, CrowdStrike's senior veep in the counter adversary division, North Korean infiltrators are bagging roles worldwide throughout the year. Thousands are said to have
infiltrated
the Fortune 500.
They're masking IPs, exporting laptop farms to America so they can connect into those machines and appear to be working from the USA, and they are using AI – but there's a question during job interviews that never fails to catch them out and forces them to drop out of the recruitment process.
"My favorite interview question, because we've interviewed quite a few of these folks, is something to the effect of 'How fat is Kim Jong Un?' They terminate the call instantly, because it's not worth it to say something negative about that," he
told
a panel session at the
RSA Conference
in San Francisco Monday.
Meyers explained the North Koreans will use generative AI to develop bulk batches of LinkedIn profiles and applications for remote work jobs that appeal to Western companies. During an interview, multiple teams will work on the technical challenges that are part of the interview while the "front man" handles the physical side of the interview, although sometimes rather ineptly.
"One of the things that we've noted is that you'll have a person in Poland applying with a very complicated name," he recounted, "and then when you get them on Zoom calls it's a military age male Asian who can't pronounce it." But it works enough that quite a few score the job and millions of dollars are being funneled back to North Korea via this route.
Once placed in the coveted role, such workers are usually very successful in the company, since they have multiple people working on one job to produce the best work possible - with the hope of getting a promotion and more access to the business' systems - explained panelist FBI Special Agent Elizabeth Pelker.
"I think more often than not, I get the comment of 'Oh, but Johnny is our best performer. Do we actually need to fire him?" she said.
The aims of
these phony workers
are two-fold, she explained. Firstly, they earn a wage and use their access to steal intellectual property from the victim. This is usually exfiltrated in tiny chunks so as to not trigger security systems.
One mitigation strategy, she said, was to insist that any interviewee performed coding tests within the corporate environment. These allow the actual IP being used to get checked, interviewers to see how often the prospect is switching between screens, and can allow other clues to leak out that all is not as it seems.
If the interloper is exposed and fired, however, they will usually have already collected login details, planted unactivated malware, and will then attempt to extort the maximum they can from the victim. She urged anyone who spots a fake employee to contact their local FBI field office immediately.
The Red Queen's race
But the attackers are getting smarter, and in some ways the FBI is a victim of its own success.
The agency has been distributing
advice
to US companies but these memos are also being read in Pyongyang and the workers are adapting their tactics. This sometimes involves using both aware and unwitting accomplices.
For example, to get around the IP address problem, laptop farms are springing up all over America. If an applicant gets a job, the firm will usually send him a laptop, at which point the interviewee explains that they've moved or have a family emergency, so could they send it to a new address please?
North Korea's fake tech workers now targeting European employers
Arizona laptop farmer pleads guilty for funneling $17M to Kim Jong Un
US 'laptop farm' man accused of outsourcing his IT jobs to North Korea to fund weapons programs
North Korean dev who renamed himself 'Bane' accused of IT worker fraud caper
Security biz KnowBe4 hired fake North Korean techie, who got straight to work ... on evil
I'm a security expert, and I almost fell for a North Korea-style deepfake job applicant …Twice
North Koreans clone open source projects to plant backdoors, steal credentials
This is most likely a laptop farm, where someone in the US agrees to run the laptop from a legitimate address for a fee, typically around $200 a computer, according to Meyers. Last year the FBI
busted
one such operation in Nashville, Tennessee, and charged the operator with conspiracy to cause damage to protected computers, conspiracy to launder monetary instruments, conspiracy to commit wire fraud, intentional damage to protected computers, aggravated identity theft, and conspiracy to cause the unlawful employment of alie

data.title: How the US defense secretary circumvents official DoD communications equipment
data.author: Harvesterify
data.article_summary: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯（Pete Hegseth）被报道在办公室使用一台私人电脑，通过直接连接公共互联网来使用Signal通讯应用。尽管赫格斯拥有多种安全和非安全的政府通讯设备，包括Cisco IP电话、集成服务电话（IST-2）和连接不同安全网络的电脑（如NIPRNet、SIPRNet和JWICS），他仍选择使用私人设备进行通讯。由于无法在政府设备上安装Signal，赫格斯起初通过办公室的Wi-Fi使用该应用，后来甚至申请了一条直接连接公共互联网的线路，绕过了五角大楼的安保协议。这种做法存在安全风险，因为直接互联网连接不如NIPRNet等网络安全。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕加密技术、政府通讯安全、以及相关政治和操作问题的讨论

不同观点：
• Waterluvian提出是否存在一种加密技术，使得信息只能在未来的特定日期后解密，并探讨了这种技术实现的可能性，如依赖可信机构广播伪随机数生成器。
• Beloch讨论了公钥加密（如Signal使用的）在保护长期秘密方面的局限性，指出即使避免了中间人攻击，未来技术进步可能使当前的加密信息被破解，特别是涉及国家机密时。
• Flexorium关注实际操作中的技术设备，提到KVM切换器可能用于在JWICS和SIPRNET之间切换，并猜测这是一种专门设备。
• StandardUser批评了让不合格的人担任高职的现象，认为这种 incompetence 会影响最高层的决策质量。
• Mmooss提出了一个假设性问题，如何在一个公共网络上找到特定个人的计算机，这似乎是一个关于网络侦查的思维实验。
• Lwansbrough建议制作一部类似《白宫风云》的剧集，但带有严重 incompetence 的元素，以揭示某些决策者的思维方式。
• Netbioserror指出国防部及其他部门已多年默许使用Signal进行内部事务处理，并强调适当的操作安全（opsec）措施。
• Wmf建议技术专家开发易用且安全的政府协作软件，以提高政府效率。
• Purpleidea推测某人使用加密通讯的动机可能是为了避免被信号情报人员监视或逃避官方记录。
• Codeulike虽然不喜欢特朗普政府，但理解政府官员需要快速、便捷的通讯工具，如Signal或WhatsApp，以应对现代决策的速度。
• JensRantil半开玩笑地提到，某些高层官员需要与总统有直接的加密通讯线路，以确保决策流程。
• Jmyeet批评了国防部禁止使用Signal却允许高层例外的情况，并提出三个问题：为何例外、如何添加未经授权的人员、以及删除Signal消息是否规避法律。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及的争议焦点包括政府通讯工具的选择、加密技术在长期保密中的有效性、以及高层决策者使用非传统通讯手段的合法性和安全性问题。
• 另一个值得注意的点是关于 incompetence 在高层决策中的影响，以及技术工具在政府运作中的适当应用。

43851612.article_content:
Last week it was reported that US defense secretary
Pete Hegseth
has a private computer with a direct link to the public internet in his office, in order to use the messaging app
Signal
.
Here I will look at the secretary of defense's
official communications equipment
and the
SecDef Cables
communications center. There's also a photo in which Hegseth's
private computer
can be recognized.
US defense secretary Pete Hegseth in his office in the Pentagon, January 30, 2025
(Still from a
video message
on X, formerly Twitter)
Hegseth's government equipment
Like his predecessors, Trump's defense secretary Pete Hegseth has access to a range of secure and non-secure telephone and computer networks. The equipment is installed at a table behind his back, when sitting at his big writing desk in the Pentagon.
In the photo above we can see that equipment in a set-up that has basically been
unchanged
since Chuck Hagel, who was Obama's secretary of Defense from 2013 to 2015. In the photo of Pete Hegseth we see from left to right:
- On top of a wooden stand sits a Cisco IP Phone 8851 with a 14-key
expansion module
. This phone is part of the Crisis Management System (CMS), which connects the President, the National Security Council, Cabinet members, the Joint Chiefs of Staff, intelligence agency watch centers, and others. Its bright yellow bezel indicates that it can be used for conversations up to Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI).
- Below the CMS phone on the wooden stand is (hardly visible) an
Integrated Services Telephone-2
(IST-2), which can be used for both secure and non-secure phone calls. This phone belongs to the
Defense Red Switch Network
(DRSN), also known as the Multilevel Secure Voice service, which connects the White House, all military command centers, intelligence agencies, government departments and NATO allies.
- Right in front of the IST-2 is another Cisco IP Phone 8851 with a 14-key expansion module, but this time with a green bezel, which indicates that it's for unclassified phone calls. This phone is part of the internal telephone network of the Pentagon and replaced an
Avaya Lucent 6424
executive phone.
A better view of these phones is provided by the following photo from 2021:
Former secretary of defense Lloyd Austin in his Pentagon office in 2021,
with a Cisco IP phone with yellow bezel for the CMS and
an IST-2 phone with many red buttons for the DRSN.
(DoD photo - click to enlarge)
- Besides the telephones there are two computer screens, both with a bright green wallpaper, which again indicates that they are connected to an unclassified network, most likely
NIPRNet
. In the photo of Lloyd Austin's office we see that there's also a
KVM switch
which is used to switch securely to the
SIPRNet
(Secret) and
JWICS
(Top Secret/SCI) networks, using the same keyboard, video and mouse set.
- Finally, at the right side of the table there are two
Cisco Webex DX80
videoteleconferencing screens. The one at the right has a yellow label, which indicates that it's approved for Top Secret/SCI and most likely belongs to the Secure Video Teleconferencing System (SVTS), which is part of the aforementioned Crisis Management System (CMS). The other screen might then be for videoconferences at a lower classification level.
> See also:
US military and intelligence computer networks
Hegseth's personal computer
Despite the wide range of options for communicating via the proper and secure government channels, secretary Hegseth insisted on using Signal. Apparently it wasn't allowed or possible to install this app on one of the government computers, nor on a smartphone that is approved for classified conversations.
Therefore, Hegseth initially went to the back area of his office where he could access Wi-Fi to use Signal,
according
to AP News. It's not clear whether he used a private laptop or his personal smartphone, both of which would have been strictly forbidden to use in secure areas like this.
> See:
The equipment that Trump's national security team should have used
Somewhat later, Hegseth requested an internet connection to his desk where he could use a computer of his own. This line connects directly to the public internet and bypassed the Pentagon's security protocols. This new computer must be the one that can be seen in the photo below, as it wasn't there yet on
February 21
and has no labels that indicate its classification level:
US defense secretary with a new desktop computer on his desk, March 20, 2025
(DoD photo, see also this
video message
on X)
Some other employees at the Pentagon also
use

43851612.article_summary: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯（Pete Hegseth）被报道在办公室使用一台私人电脑，通过直接连接公共互联网来使用Signal通讯应用。尽管赫格斯拥有多种安全和非安全的政府通讯设备，包括Cisco IP电话、集成服务电话（IST-2）和连接不同安全网络的电脑（如NIPRNet、SIPRNet和JWICS），他仍选择使用私人设备进行通讯。由于无法在政府设备上安装Signal，赫格斯起初通过办公室的Wi-Fi使用该应用，后来甚至申请了一条直接连接公共互联网的线路，绕过了五角大楼的安保协议。这种做法存在安全风险，因为直接互联网连接不如NIPRNet等网络安全。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：美国企业受关税影响及将生产转移回美国的可行性

不同观点：
• [prof-dr-ir] 和 [danesparza] 提到，HYTE和Adafruit等公司通过视频分享了关税对其成本结构和生产的影响，并讨论将生产转移到美国的可能性。[prof-dr-ir] 特别指出，HYTE考虑将生产转移到美国，以减少关税影响。

• [almosthere] 认为，许多新公司可能会在印度、台湾、越南和韩国等地涌现，通过从中国购买组件再转售到美国，但这种方式对解决问题没有实质帮助。

• [voidUpdate] 提问关税对美国的具体好处是什么，显示出对关税政策的实际效果存在疑惑。

• [pavlov] 反对在美国建厂，理由包括建厂时间长、设备和原材料的高关税、高工资以及政治环境不稳定等因素，认为这些都会影响投资回报。

• [Scottn1] 指出，关税已经对桌游行业造成严重影响，导致一些公司减缓生产和裁员，甚至关闭。他提供了相关链接以支持其论点。

• [sleepyguy] 引用Ryan Pertersen的观点，指出如果关税持续，80%从中国采购的小企业将破产，200万个工作岗位将流失，而大公司因获得豁免不受影响。

• [techpineapple] 认为，如果企业正在讨论将生产转移到美国，这可能说明关税政策正在起作用。

补充讨论：
• [averageRoyalty] 对Wyze公司背景进行了补充，指出其为智能家居公司，由前亚马逊员工创立，可能生产智能 floodlights。

• [bananalychee] 关心关税对零售价值的影响，并提到一些公司透明地将关税成本转嫁给消费者，但不同行业的利润率差异可能导致影响不同。

• [vfclists] 提问如果企业在美国生产，是否仍需为进口设备支付关税，这显示出对具体关税规定的疑惑。

• [therealfiona] 提到个人经历，Wyze曾使她的灯泡无法使用，因此对该公司遭遇的困境缺乏同情。

• [inverted_flag] 提到Wyze在回复中受到攻击，提供了相关链接。

• [blitzar] 以讽刺口吻称关税政策为“假新闻”，暗示关税的实际承担者是消费者而非中国。

争议焦点：
• 关税政策是否有效以及其对美国经济的实际影响。一方认为关税促使企业考虑将生产转移回美国，另一方则认为关税会导致小企业破产和大规模失业。

data.title: Ask HN: 3rd Week at FAANG and feeling imposter syndrome
data.author: HowDoesSound
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新人在大型科技公司（FAANG等）中的适应问题，是否属于“冒名顶替综合症”（imposter syndrome），以及团队和环境的复杂性。

不同观点：
• hnfong：认为问题不一定是冒名顶替综合症，而可能是文化冲击或不匹配。大型团队开发的软件本身就很复杂，新人需要更多时间适应。如果团队没有为新人提供良好的入职流程，问题会更加突出。
• romanhn：认为冒名顶替综合症在大型科技公司非常普遍，尤其是从非大厂加入的资深人员。适应过程是沉浮自如的，需要自我调整和善待自己。
• donavanm：根据自身经验，新人需要大约三个月才能理解公司运作。建议积极提问，并与“入职伙伴”和经理保持沟通。大型企业的复杂性是规模导致的，适应需要时间。
• al_borland：在一家F250公司工作，认为公司引入大量刚毕业的新人后，系统变得混乱。虽然公司可能 dysfunctional，但坚持一到两年对简历有帮助。
• commandersaki：在亚马逊工作八个月，觉得环境和系统过于复杂，且前六个月缺乏明确任务，最终觉得自己不适合而离开。
• uptownfunk：认为现在处于“后FAANG时代”，许多私营公司（如Stripe, Databricks）同样具有吸引力。
• austin-cheney：从未在FAANG工作，但经历过类似情况。建议积极寻求帮助，并编写个人文档以记录学习过程。
• rkwasny：认为从小型公司进入大型公司后的适应问题是常见的，需要适应更严格的流程和审批过程。
• owebmaster：认为新人对系统的复杂性缺乏了解，建议虚心请教，不应过早对系统做出负面评价。
• Clubber：建议至少坚持两年，认为大公司经验对职业生涯有益。
• almosthere、chistev：对新人被录用表示惊讶和肯定。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于新人是否真的面临冒名顶替综合症，还是仅仅是环境和流程的复杂性导致的不适应。
• 新人对大型企业系统的复杂性和过工程化（overengineered）的批评引发了一些争议，有人认为新人缺乏足够的经验做出这种判断。
• 强调了积极沟通、提问和记录学习过程的重要性，以及适应大型企业文化和工作流程的必要性。
• 有人提到现代大企业的 dysfunctional 性质，并建议新人调整期望，认识到企业实际运作中的混乱和复杂。

data.title: The Fantasy of a Nonprofit Dating App
data.author: handfuloflight
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了人们在使用约会应用程序时的沮丧和怀疑，特别是对应用程序是否故意操纵匹配以赚取更多费用的担忧。一些研究和诉讼指出，约会平台可能通过操纵算法，使用户陷入“付费循环”，难以找到合适的伴侣。尽管平台公司如Match Group声称他们的算法优先考虑活跃用户和相互兼容性，但许多人仍然对这种商业模式失去信任。文章还提到，一些政府推出了由国家资助的约会平台，以应对结婚率和生育率下降的问题，如东京和中国的某些城市。作者探讨了是否存在不以盈利为目的的约会应用程序，并发现确实有一些由政府或科学家运营的非营利性约会平台，尽管这些平台也可能引发对隐私和政治干预的担忧。总的来说，文章反映了现代约会中的信任危机和对替代解决方案的探索。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：科学家的参与能否改善约会应用以及当前约会应用的商业模式问题

不同观点：
• **stevage** 认为科学家运营的约会应用是一个有趣的想法，但可能带来实验纯洁性与参与者需求之间的利益冲突。他指出，人们通常不擅长识别哪些特质对他们是重要的，或者判断一个人是否具备这些特质。因此，他认为这个领域有待颠覆。

• **pinewurst** 没有直接发表观点，而是通过提供存档链接让读者自行查阅相关内容，保持中立或引导讨论。

• **cantrecallmypwd** 批评现有的约会应用主要是为了通过技术中介从社交能力较弱的人群中获利，而不是真正帮助他们提升社交技能。他认为，如果约会应用真正关心用户的社会关系发展，应该聚焦于提升社交技能、促进积极的社会领导力和倡议，而不是通过鼓励仓促行为、利用愤怒情绪和肤浅互动来增加广告收入。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：约会应用的核心问题在于其商业模式是否真正服务于用户的社交需求。stevage 认为科学家参与可以改善用户体验，但可能面临实验与商业需求的冲突。cantrecallmypwd 则认为当前的应用本质上是在剥削用户，强调需要彻底改变其商业逻辑以真正造福用户。

• **共同点**：两者都认为当前的约会应用存在问题，stevage 强调用户自身识别能力的不足，而 cantrecallmypwd 则聚焦于应用的商业模式剥削问题，但他们都认为这个领域需要变革。

• **论据和例子**：stevage 提到科学家可能更擅长识别重要特质，但面临实验纯洁性问题。cantrecallmypwd 提供了对当前约会应用商业模式的批判，认为它们更关注利润而非用户福祉。

总结：讨论围绕科学家参与能否改善约会应用以及当前应用的商业模式问题展开，stevage 持谨慎乐观态度，而 cantrecallmypwd 则持批判态度，焦点在于如何真正提升用户的社交体验。

Spending time on dating apps, I know from experience, can make you a little paranoid. When you swipe and swipe and nothing’s working out, it could be that you’ve had bad luck. It could be that you’re too picky. It could be—oh God—that you simply don’t pull like you thought you did. But sometimes, whether out of self-protection or righteous skepticism of corporate motives, you might think:
Maybe the nameless faces who created this product are conspiring against me to turn a profit—meddling in my dating life so that I’ll spend the rest of my days alone, paying for any feature that gives me a shred of hope.
The gnawing suspicion is a common one. In one 2024
study
, researchers analyzed more than 7,000 online reviews of Tinder and interviewed 30 Tinder users, and found that many people believe that dating sites are messing with their profile’s visibility, manipulating their matches, and knowingly providing options that aren’t good fits. The study’s co-authors called it the “conflict of interest theory”: that dating-app companies (which want customers) have interests fundamentally at odds with those of many dating-app users (specifically, those who want to find someone and delete the app ASAP). The idea was so familiar to the researchers whom I interviewed while reporting this article that I hardly needed to explain it.
Some wariness of dating sites is understandable. One recent
investigation
found that, more and more, apps are nudging people to pay for perks—visibility boosts, unlimited likes—marketed as tools for finding love. Last year, a class-action
lawsuit
argued that Match Group, which owns Tinder, Hinge, Match.com, and several other apps, locks its users into “a perpetual pay-to-play loop” at the expense of “customers’ relationship goals.” (“We actively strive to get people on dates every day and off our apps,” Match Group responded in a
statement
. “Anyone who states anything else doesn’t understand the purpose and mission of our entire industry.” In December, a judge sent the case to arbitration.)
Read: The slow, quiet demise of American romance
Whether for-profit app companies are in fact trying to hinder people’s romantic game is questionable. Match Group keeps the details of its algorithms and strategies under lock, but a spokesperson told me that “the best scenario for us is for someone to find their partner using one of our products, and then tell other people about it … Our algorithms are designed to prioritize active users and mutual compatibility—not to keep people stuck in an endless loop.” And it’s not like companies need to worry about there being a finite supply of single people. You wouldn’t expect a therapist to undermine her clients’ treatment for the sake of income; plenty of people have problems that could use some talking through. Brutally, that 2024 paper determined that app skeptics might just be avoiding responsibility for their own “dating failures,” blaming a lack of matches on evil capitalist overlords instead of “their own actions or attractiveness.” (I flinched.)
Regardless, the fact that so many believe the theory suggests that modern dating isn’t working for a lot of people—and that for-profit matchmaking companies have, to a significant degree, lost the trust of their base. American romance isn’t
exactly thriving
, as I’ve reported: Some singles are quitting the apps, and others are
quitting dating
altogether. But recently, I started wondering whether another solution might be out there, one that still allows people to meet online and set up a date (rather than begging friends for a
setup
or hoping for a
meet-cute
). What I wanted to find, really, was a site that doesn’t try to make money: a nonprofit dating app.
A handful of them actually exist. Some are run by governments, and at least one option comes from scientists. So I set out to explore these alternatives, hoping to understand whether the experience of virtual courtship might ever change.
The most common type of nonprofit dating app, I quickly discovered, is the state-sponsored site, which is typically created in response to flagging marriage and fertility rates. Last fall, the Tokyo Metropolitan Government launched a dating platform, Tokyo Enmusubi, which
uses AI
to suggest matches—and which, according to the Japanese newspaper
The Asahi Shimbun
, cost $1.28 million to develop. Guixi, a city in China,
unveiled
a dating-app venture in 2023; it draws on state-gathered data to make matches for its customers and then sends them off on blind dates. Terengganu, a region in West Malaysia, is developing an app too, which the local government said on Facebook
is designed to
“strengthen the family institution in the state.” If it sounds a little creepy for political leaders to be reaching into people’s intimate lives in this way—well, you might not be wrong.
Researchers did tell me that stat

Offline-First with CouchDB and PouchDB in 2025
posted Wednesday, March 26, 2025 by The Neighbourhoodie Team
